title: Exact retained producer gap before DMA predecessor acceptance
question: Were the missing readings in evaluations 42 and 43 caused by source selection, the candidate producer, or later acceptance, and does the existing contextual producer close the observed gap?
method: Reopen exact retained origin reports with the ordinary run-bound Reader, distinguish decoder proposals from assembly and policy outcomes, and replay the existing contextual CPU producer on the authenticated source and retained annotations. Preserve independent reference and selection authority.
commands: UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run ci eval operation-event-availability 407 --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run ci eval operation-event-availability 437 --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json

inputs.role: Read-only exact predecessor candidate origin trace
Existing named native CPU candidate replay over authenticated inputs

outputs.role: Detached decoder and private-record origin trace for three exact retained views
Detached CPU challenger result over the current exact subsection view
Detached CPU challenger result over the retained whole Preface view

results.name: Contextual Preface assembled private records
results.note: The only assertion changes the independently adjudicated reading; no trial-bound measurement was assembled.

conclusion: The retained default producer misses source roles before record acceptance, and no fitted whole-reading acceptance policy ran. Contextual native CPU decoding returned more partial subsection proposals and no assembled records, and one role-shifted Preface assertion with no measurement. The independent grades remain unchanged, no candidate acquired public standing, and neither run is an eligible DMA-13 predecessor.
